title: IEC 61511 Clause 17.2 SIS Management-of-Change (MoC) register: classification, MoC-impact-on-SIL, re-assessment trigger, and Pre-Startup Safety Review (PSSR) closure
exclusions: Excludes like-for-like-spare-part replacements where the replaced component is identical (same vendor part-number, same firmware revision) — these are excluded from MoC per IEC 61511 Clause 17.2.2.b. Excludes adjustments within the documented operating envelope (set-point trims within the approved range).
evidence: Saved search `UC-22.63.5` archived daily to `audit_evidence` with `iec_clause="IEC-61511-Cl-17-2"`. Every change pins (moc_id, sis_id, change_class, sil_impact_assessed, cra_re_executed, pssr_completed_at, pssr_findings_status, risk_score).

compliance.assurance_rationale: IEC 61511-1 Clause 17.2 requires that any change to the SIS (hardware, software, configuration, application program, scope of safety function, demand rate, or operating environment) be subjected to a formal Management-of-Change (MoC) workflow that re-traces the lifecycle phases affected. This UC enforces five MoC-discipline limbs: (i) change classification per Clause 17.2.2 (replacement-in-kind vs MoC), (ii) SIL-impact assessment, (iii) CRA re-execution per Clause 8.2.4 if cyber-relevant, (iv) Pre-Startup Safety Review (PSSR) closure, (v) lifecycle-deliverable updates.
compliance.controlObjective: Demonstrates that every SIS MoC is properly classified, SIL-impact-assessed, CRA-refreshed if cyber-relevant, and PSSR-closed before re-startup.
compliance.evidenceArtifact: Saved search archived to `audit_evidence`, the `SIS MoC Register` dashboard, the per-MoC SIL-impact assessment, the per-MoC PSSR report, the per-MoC updated SIS-SRS extracts.

compliance.assurance_rationale: Clause 8.2.4 mandates a CRA re-execution on any significant change to the SIS or its environment. This UC enforces the MoC-triggered CRA re-execution limb (the change-trigger side); the periodic-CRA limb is enforced by UC-22.63.2.
compliance.controlObjective: Provides the change-triggered CRA-refresh limb of Clause 8.2.4.

controlTest.positiveScenario: UC-22.63.5 positive (IEC, 61511, Clause, 17.2, SIS): ingest synthetic events into `index=target_index` sourcetype='target_sourcetype' where `count` grouped by `entity` satisfies `days_in_moc_workflow` > 365, or `risk_score` > 0 for 'IEC 61511 Clause 17.2 SIS Management-of-Change (MoC) register: classification, MoC-impact-on-SIL, re-assessment trigger, and Pre-Startup Safety Review (PSSR) closure'.  Run the saved search and confirm at least one alertable row.
controlTest.negativeScenario: UC-22.63.5 negative ((PSSR) closure): ingest benign `target_index` / `target_sourcetype` events where `entity` stays below `days_in_moc_workflow` > 365, or `risk_score` > 0, or exclude the test entity via `compliance_exception_register.csv`. Variant 1 confirms zero alert rows for 'IEC 61511 Clause 17.2 SIS Management-of-Change (MoC) register: classification, MoC-impact-on-SIL, re-assessment trigger, and Pre-Startup Safety Review (PSSR) closure'.

dataSources: KV Store `iec_61511_sis_moc_register_lookup` (moc_id, sis_id, change_class, change_description, change_initiator, change_class_reviewer_ref, sil_impact_assessed_at, sil_impact_finding, cra_re_executed_at, cra_re_assessor_ref, pssr_completed_at, pssr_findings_status, change_implemented_at). MoC platform events via HEC `hec:moc:event`. Document-management system events.
app: Splunk Enterprise Security (Splunkbase 263), Splunk Add-on for ServiceNow (Splunkbase 1928).
spl:
| inputlookup iec_61511_sis_moc_register_lookup
| eval now_ts = now()
| eval change_class_reviewed = if(isnotnull(change_class_reviewer_ref), 1, 0)
| eval sil_impact_assessed_done = if(isnotnull(sil_impact_assessed_at), 1, 0)
| eval cyber_relevant_change = if(change_class IN ("hardware","software","firmware","network","application-program","interconnection","engineering-workstation-rebuild"), 1, 0)
| eval cra_required = if(cyber_relevant_change = 1 OR sil_impact_finding IN ("increase","degrade"), 1, 0)
| eval cra_re_done = if(isnotnull(cra_re_executed_at), 1, 0)
| eval pssr_required = if(change_class != "replacement-in-kind", 1, 0)
| eval pssr_done = if(isnotnull(pssr_completed_at) AND pssr_findings_status IN ("closed","closed-with-comments"), 1, 0)
| eval pssr_open_findings = if(pssr_findings_status IN ("open","in-progress"), 1, 0)
| eval changes_implemented_without_proper_workflow = if(isnotnull(change_implemented_at) AND (change_class_reviewed = 0 OR sil_impact_assessed_done = 0 OR (cra_required = 1 AND cra_re_done = 0) OR (pssr_required = 1 AND pssr_done = 0)), 1, 0)
| eval days_in_moc_workflow = if(isnotnull(change_implemented_at), null(), round((now_ts - moc_opened_at) / 86400, 1))
| eval moc_stalled = if(isnotnull(days_in_moc_workflow) AND days_in_moc_workflow > 365, 1, 0)
| eval risk_score = case(
    changes_implemented_without_proper_workflow = 1, 100,
    change_class = "replacement-in-kind" AND cyber_relevant_change = 1, 95,
    pssr_required = 1 AND isnotnull(change_implemented_at) AND pssr_done = 0, 95,
    cra_required = 1 AND isnotnull(change_implemented_at) AND cra_re_done = 0, 95,
    sil_impact_assessed_done = 0 AND isnotnull(change_implemented_at), 90,
    pssr_open_findings = 1, 60,
    moc_stalled = 1, 50,
    1=1, 0)
| where risk_score > 0
| sort 0 -risk_score, +pssr_completed_at
| table moc_id sis_id change_class sil_impact_finding cra_re_executed_at pssr_completed_at pssr_findings_status changes_implemented_without_proper_workflow risk_score
description: Monitors (PSSR) closure activity in UC-22.63.5 ('IEC 61511 Clause 17.2 SIS Management-of-Change (MoC) register: classification, MoC-impact-on-SIL, re-assessment trigger, and Pre-Startup Safety Review (PSSR) closure') from `index=target_index` sourcetype `configured sourcetype`. Rolls up `count` by `entity` across `the scheduled window` and pages when `days_in_moc_workflow` > 365, or `risk_score` > 0. Covers IEC, 61511, Clause, 17.2, SIS. Compliance operators treat UC-22.63.5 as the canonical signal.
value: Operators running UC-22.63.5 on UC-22.63.5 search results shorten triage for (PSSR) closure tied to 'IEC 61511 Clause 17.2 SIS Management-of-Change (MoC) register: classification, MoC-impact-on-SIL, re-assessment trigger, and Pre-Startup Safety Review (PSSR) closure', lowering audit findings, regulatory gaps, and attestation delays.
implementation: (1) Maintain `iec_61511_sis_moc_register_lookup` as the system of record. (2) Hook the corporate MoC platform (Sphera Stature / Enablon / SAP-MoC / ServiceNow HSE MoC) to `hec:moc:event` for change-event ingestion. (3) Add a `cyber_relevance` decision-tree to the MoC platform that auto-classifies hardware / software / firmware / network / EWS-rebuild changes as cyber-relevant. (4) Schedule UC-22.63.5 daily; route `risk_score = 100` to the Functional Safety Manager + Plant Manager + Process Safety Manager at severity P1, with mandatory regulator-notification consideration.

knownFalsePositives:
1. **Authorised IEC 61511 control testing** — Internal audit exercises 'IEC 61511 Clause 17.2 SIS Management-of-Change (MoC) register: classification, MoC-impact-on-SIL, re-assessment trigger, and Pre-Startup Safety Review (PSSR) closure' (UC-22.63.5) on `entity` during scheduled clause IEC-61511-Cl-17-2 sampling. Match compliance programme calendar.

2. **External assessor sampling** — QSA activity spikes `index=audit_evidence` `configured sourcetype` without crossing `days_in_moc_workflow` > 365. Cross-check engagement letter in `iec_61511_exception_register.csv`.

3. **Planned maintenance affecting control telemetry** — CAB change pauses ingestion to `audit_evidence` for `entity`. Compare `_time` with active change record.

4. **Third-party processor under contract** — BAA/DPA-covered vendor generates expected rows grouped by `entity` during normal service delivery.

**Suppression mechanism:** `iec_61511_exception_register.csv` keyed on `entity`, `exception_reason`, `valid_until`, joined before alert threshold.
reviewer: Functional Safety Manager + Process Safety Manager + Plant Manager + Internal Audit
detailedImplementation:
## Prerequisites

- An MoC platform (Sphera Stature / Enablon / SAP-MoC / ServiceNow HSE MoC) wired to Splunk.
- A documented MoC procedure aligned to OSHA PSM 1910.119(l) (US) / COMAH (UK) / Seveso III (EU) / MSIHC Rules (India).
- A PSSR procedure with documented finding-closure workflow.

## Step 1 - MoC register KV Store

```ini
[iec_61511_sis_moc_register_lookup]
enforceTypes = true
field.moc_id = string
field.sis_id = string
field.change_class = string
field.change_description = string
field.change_initiator = string
field.moc_opened_at = time
field.change_class_reviewer_ref = string
field.sil_impact_assessed_at = time
field.sil_impact_finding = string
field.cra_re_executed_at = time
field.cra_re_assessor_ref = string
field.pssr_completed_at = time
field.pssr_findings_status = string
field.change_implemented_at = time
field.replacement_in_kind_evidence_ref = string
field.emergency_moc_ref = string
```

## Step 2 - Schedule

```ini
[UC-22.63.5: SIS Management of Change]
cron_schedule = 0 8 * * *
dispatch.earliest_time = -1d@d
dispatch.latest_time = now
actions = summary_index, notable
action.summary_index._name = audit_evidence
action.summary_index.marker = uc=22.63.5,reg=IEC-61511,clause=IEC-61511-Cl-17-2
alert.severity = 5
```

## Step 3 - Functional-safety-specific notes

- **Cyber-relevance decision tree**: any change to hardware, firmware, application program, network configuration, or engineering-workstation toolchain is cyber-relevant by default — the MoC-platform decision tree should err toward triggering a CRA refresh.
- **PSSR independence**: the PSSR team should not include the change implementer — this independence is itself an audit point.

Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (Splunk Enterprise Security (Splunkbase 263), Splunk Add-on for ServiceNow (Splunkbase 1928).). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=see SPL into index=main. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower. Grant the ingestion role `list_inputs` and `search` on the target index.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert

Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages. Document tunable macros in the comment header. Understanding this SPL: filters in the first pipeline reduce license cost; stats/timechart aggregates define the alert grain; joins/lookups enrich owner or asset metadata for routing.

Step 3 — Validate

Compare `| tstats count where index=... sourcetype=...` against the vendor admin UI inventory count (+/-5%). Spot-check two known entities for field presence (`change_class_reviewed, changes_implemented_without_proper_workflow, cra_re_done, cra_required`). Run `timechart count span=1h` over 7 days to find ingestion gaps longer than two poll intervals.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Add a dashboard row with single-value KPI tiles, a 24-hour timechart, and a drilldown table mirroring the SPL output columns. Route critical severity to the platform on-call channel; route warning to the service owner from the lookup.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

No events: verify forwarder connectivity, HEC token ACLs, and that the modular input appears in `index=_internal source=*splunkd*`. NULL fields: check props/transforms order and TA version. Fewer results than expected: confirm index allow-lists on the search head role and that `_time` uses the correct timezone. API errors: inspect splunkd.log for HTTP 401/429 from the vendor endpoint configured in inputs.conf.
grandmaExplanation: Any change to a safety system — even a small one — could create new risks. Every change must be reviewed by safety experts, the cyber-risk re-checked, and a final safety review done before the system goes back into service. We check daily that no shortcut is taken.
